description: MCP 서버 중앙 레지스트리 — 진실의 원천

policy_notes.transport: Server transport accepts "hub-url" for triflux Hub URL flow, "http" for direct Streamable HTTP MCP endpoints, or "stdio" for upstream-stdio-only MCP servers (rare; only for servers that have no hosted HTTP endpoint, e.g. brave-search). stdio servers require command, args, and may include env.
policy_notes.headers: Optional headers are allowed only for HTTP-compatible transports. Each header value must be a descriptor: {"value":"literal"} for non-secret static values, {"env":"ENV_VAR_NAME"} for secrets resolved at sync/runtime, or {"env":"ENV_VAR_NAME","prefix":"Bearer "} for common authorization formats.
policy_notes.secret_safety: Resolved secret values must not be written back to this registry file. Missing env vars warn during sync and do not emit empty secret headers.
policy_notes.sync_denylist: Array of client:server strings skipped by proactive registry sync, for example gemini:tfx-hub.

context7.description: Upstash Context7 — 라이브러리 문서/코드 컨텍스트 (HTTP MCP, API key 불필요)

exa.description: Exa neural/semantic web search — 학술/기술 깊이. Key 발급: https://exa.ai/dashboard → secrets.env의 EXA_API_KEY

brave-search.description: Brave Search MCP — stdio 양식 (공식 hosted endpoint 없음, npx 로컬 실행). BRAVE_API_KEY 환경변수 필요 (https://brave.com/search/api/). secrets.env 의 BRAVE_API_KEY 참조.

tavily.description: Tavily research — 비용/운영/DX/일반 웹. Key 발급: https://app.tavily.com/home → secrets.env의 TAVILY_API_KEY
